newsitem.title: USA: Lufthansa names U.S. western region head.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa names U.S. western region head.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo said Juergen Eckstein,has been appointed general manager of its U.S. western region based in Los Angeles.

Under Lufthansa Cargo's "Gateway" management structure, setup in January there are four U.S. regions. The others are based at New York's John F. Kennedy international airport (eastern region); Chicago's O'Hare (central region) and Atlanta's Hartsfield (southern region), it added in a statement.

The carrier offers scheduled cargo flights from Boston, Newark, Washington DC, Dallas Ft. Worth, Houston, San Francisco and Seattle, it said. - - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
